MAJOR: a backward-incompatible change to the stored data schema without a migration, the house_map.get_placements response shape, the websocket API, the SVG upload API, or the coordinate and rotation conventions.

MINOR: a backward-compatible new feature: new panel capability, new service field or filter, new websocket command, or a storage migration that keeps existing data.

PATCH: a bug fix, refactor, documentation, test, CI or dependency change with no behavior change, or a rebuilt frontend bundle with no new feature.
